dispute_ticket.description: The rider never came. I waited about 9 minutes at the pin and then cancelled. I want the S$6.00 no-show fee paid to me.

chat_logs.content: I am at Tampines Mall, Gate A.
I am at Gate B waiting, the pin is here.
I am at Gate A. Come here.
The pin is not at Gate A! Please come to Gate B

app_events.details: Rider R-7118 booked trip RYDE-DS-018. Pickup pin: Tampines Mall (the pin sits between Gate A and Gate B).
Vehicle location updates stopped (device reported GPS unavailable).
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. No GPS available to verify distance to pickup point.
Rider app location about 120 m from pickup pin (Gate B side); pings repeat to 07:31.
Driver cancelled as rider no-show. No fee applied pending review; wait counted from the 'I'm Here' tap would be 9 min.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. The count is inclusive.

arrival_requires_gps_within_m_of_pickup.text: Governs when a driver counts as arrived for waiting and no-show purposes: the driver's GPS position must be within this many metres of the pickup point.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It covers rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: This trip's policy counts the wait from when the driver's GPS is within 100 m of the pickup point, with an 8-minute inclusive threshold. The GPS record stopped at 07:20:30 and resumed at 07:33:00, covering the whole waiting period, so the driver's arrival cannot be verified. The tap at 07:22 would give 9 minutes and a no-show, but if arrival is later than 07:23 the wait is under 8 minutes. The chat and the rider's pings (about 120 m from the pin at Gate B) show both parties were near the mall at different gates around an ambiguous pin. With the arrival time unprovable and the records in conflict, a human reviewer must decide.
